description.person: According to Article 15 GDPR, you have the right to access your stored personal data. We provide this information to you through an automated process, which may take some time.
description.organization: For reasons of transparency, we offer companies the right to access your stored personal data. We provide this information to you through an automated process, which may take some time.

description.person: According to Article 17 GDPR, you have the right to request the deletion of your stored personal data. We process this request through an automated process, which may take some time.
description.organization: For reasons of transparency, we offer companies the right to request the deletion of your stored personal data. We process this request through an automated process, which may take some time.

description.person: According to Article 21 GDPR, you have the right to object to the processing of your personal data. Additionally, you can use this method to request a restriction of processing according to Article 18 GDPR. Please use the form below to explain your concern.
description.organization: For reasons of transparency, we offer companies the right to object to the processing of your personal data.Please use the form below to explain your concern.

description.person: We place great importance on the accuracy of your data and uphold your right to rectification in accordance with Article 16 GDPR. If your data contains errors or requires changes, please inform us about it.
description.organization: We place great importance on the accuracy of your data. If your data contains errors or requires changes, please inform us about it.

intro_section.title: Data Protection Rights
intro_section.description: As a public health department, we offer you the opportunity to obtain information about your stored data, correct it, delete it, or object to its processing. For more details about your rights, please read our <InternalLink href="/datenschutz">privacy policy</InternalLink>.

your_rights_section.description: You can address concerns regarding your stored data both online and in person at the public health department. We look forward to welcoming you there and are happy to assist you with your concerns.

internet.title: Internet
internet.description:
The digital process requires a clear identification of your person or your company to ensure that only you can access your data.

Therefore, private individuals need to verify their identity with <BundIdLink href="#">BundID</BundIdLink>, while companies need to verify their identity with <MukLink href="#">Mein Unternehmenskonto</MukLink>.

Please note that some services of GA-Lotse may not be immediately available after the initial login.

unlinked.title: Your data
unlinked.description: Your profile data is currently not available. You can request a data report to view the data we have on file for you.

contact_form.title: Correcting information
contact_form.description: We place great importance on the accuracy of your data. If your stored data contains errors or needs to be updated, please inform us using the contact form.

RIGHT_OF_ACCESS.title: Request data
RIGHT_OF_ACCESS.description: We are initiating an automated process to query your data.

RIGHT_TO_ERASURE.description: This action cannot be undone. We are initiating an automated process to delete your data.

RIGHT_TO_RECTIFICATION.title: Request correction
RIGHT_TO_RECTIFICATION.description: Your are being redirected to your profil page. On this page you can open the contact form to request a correction of your data.
